title: 學華語向前走 2A — Lesson 6
description: Vocabulary from lesson 6 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2A, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.hanzi: 農曆新年在一月或二月。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nónglì xīnnián zài yīyuè huò èryuè.
exampleSentences.english: The Lunar New Year is in January or February.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 很多華人過節都用農曆。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hěn duō huárén guòjié dōu yòng nónglì.
exampleSentences.english: Many Chinese people use the lunar calendar for festivals.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺翻開農曆，告訴我過年的日子。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye fān kāi nónglì, gàosu wǒ guònián de rìzi.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa opens the lunar calendar and tells me the New Year date.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 中文學校的老師拿出農曆，教我們認識月份。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōngwén xuéxiào de lǎoshī ná chū nónglì, jiāo wǒmen rènshi yuèfèn.
exampleSentences.english: The Chinese school teacher shows us the lunar calendar and teaches us the months.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師說，大家要安靜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō, dàjiā yào ānjìng.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher says everyone must be quiet.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我在家說中文。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài jiā shuō zhōngwén.
exampleSentences.english: I speak Chinese at home.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我跟媽媽說，我想吃草莓。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn māma shuō, wǒ xiǎng chī cǎoméi.
exampleSentences.english: I tell Mum I want to eat strawberries.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 校車司機叔叔跟我說早安。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàochē sījī shūshu gēn wǒ shuō zǎo'ān.
exampleSentences.english: The school bus driver says good morning to me.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 新年快樂！
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīnnián kuàilè!
exampleSentences.english: Happy New Year!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 新年是一個很重要的節日。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīnnián shì yí ge hěn zhòngyào de jiérì.
exampleSentences.english: New Year is a very important festival.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 新年的時候，我們去奶奶家吃飯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīnnián de shíhou, wǒmen qù nǎinai jiā chī fàn.
exampleSentences.english: At New Year we go to Grandma's house for dinner.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 新年的晚上，我們去海港看煙火。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīnnián de wǎnshang, wǒmen qù hǎigǎng kàn yānhuǒ.
exampleSentences.english: On New Year's night we go to the harbour to watch the fireworks.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 他是華人。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tā shì huárén.
exampleSentences.english: He is ethnic Chinese.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 世界各地都有華人。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shìjiè gèdì dōu yǒu huárén.
exampleSentences.english: There are Chinese people all over the world.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺是華人，他在家都說華語。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye shì huárén, tā zài jiā dōu shuō huáyǔ.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa is ethnic Chinese, and he speaks Mandarin at home.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的好朋友一家人都是華人，週末我們一起去公園。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de hǎo péngyou yì jiārén dōu shì huárén, zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
exampleSentences.english: My best friend's whole family is ethnic Chinese, and on the weekend we go to the park together.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下個星期我們去看爺爺。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xià ge xīngqī wǒmen qù kàn yéye.
exampleSentences.english: Next week we are going to visit Grandpa (Dad's dad).

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下一課我們學寫字。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xià yí kè wǒmen xué xiě zì.
exampleSentences.english: In the next lesson we learn to write characters.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下個星期六，我們去外婆家吃午飯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xià ge xīngqīliù, wǒmen qù wàipó jiā chī wǔfàn.
exampleSentences.english: Next Saturday we go to Grandma's house (Mum's mum) for lunch.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下次我們一起踢足球吧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xià cì wǒmen yìqǐ tī zúqiú ba.
exampleSentences.english: Next time, let's play soccer together.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天是星期一。
exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān shì xīngqīyī.
exampleSentences.english: Today is Monday.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 一個星期有七天。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yí ge xīngqī yǒu qī tiān.
exampleSentences.english: A week has seven days.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 星期六的早上，我跟爸爸去踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīngqīliù de zǎoshang, wǒ gēn bàba qù tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: On Saturday morning Dad and I go and play soccer.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 星期五放學後，我坐校車回家。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xīngqīwǔ fàngxué hòu, wǒ zuò xiàochē huíjiā.
exampleSentences.english: On Friday after school I take the school bus home.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天會下雨。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
exampleSentences.english: It will rain tomorrow.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我會乖乖坐好。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ huì guāiguāi zuò hǎo.
exampleSentences.english: I will sit nicely.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下午我們會去海灘玩水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒmen huì qù hǎitān wán shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: In the afternoon we will go to the beach to play in the water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 吃完飯以後，我們會去散步。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chī wán fàn yǐhòu, wǒmen huì qù sànbù.
exampleSentences.english: After dinner, we will go for a walk.

words.definition: New Year cake made of steamed glutinous rice, sticky cakes

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這是年糕。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì niángāo.
exampleSentences.english: This is New Year cake.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 年糕是過年吃的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: niángāo shì guònián chī de.
exampleSentences.english: New Year cake is eaten at New Year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 奶奶做了一盤年糕，我和弟弟都吃了一塊。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai zuò le yì pán niángāo, wǒ hé dìdi dōu chī le yí kuài.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma (Dad's mum) made a plate of New Year cake, and my little brother and I each ate a piece.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 外公家的年糕很好吃，我吃了三塊。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wàigōng jiā de niángāo hěn hǎochī, wǒ chī le sān kuài.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa's (Mum's dad) New Year cake is delicious, and I ate three pieces.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那天我很高興。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nàtiān wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
exampleSentences.english: I was very happy that day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那天下雨了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nàtiān xià yǔ le.
exampleSentences.english: It rained that day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那天我踢足球，進了一個球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nàtiān wǒ tī zúqiú, jìn le yí ge qiú.
exampleSentences.english: That day I played soccer and scored a goal.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那天是過年，我們吃了很多餃子。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nàtiān shì guònián, wǒmen chī le hěn duō jiǎozi.
exampleSentences.english: That day was New Year, and we ate lots of dumplings.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 給我一枝筆。
exampleSentences.pinyin: gěi wǒ yì zhī bǐ.
exampleSentences.english: Give me a pen.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我給媽媽一杯水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gěi māma yì bēi shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I give Mum a cup of water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 比賽完了，爸爸給我一瓶水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bǐsài wán le, bàba gěi wǒ yì píng shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: After the game, Dad gave me a bottle of water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我畫了一張圖，給媽媽看。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ huà le yì zhāng tú, gěi māma kàn.
exampleSentences.english: I drew a picture and showed it to Mum.

words.definition: to visit somebody during the Lunar New Year holiday

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去給爺爺奶奶拜年。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù gěi yéye nǎinai bàinián.
exampleSentences.english: We go to visit Grandpa and Grandma to wish them a happy New Year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 拜年的時候，要說新年快樂。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàinián de shíhou, yào shuō xīnnián kuàilè.
exampleSentences.english: When you visit for New Year, say Happy New Year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去外公家拜年，表哥和我一起玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù wàigōng jiā bàinián, biǎogē hé wǒ yìqǐ wán.
exampleSentences.english: We visit Grandpa's house for New Year, and my older cousin and I play together.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去唐人街，看到很多人在拜年。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù Tángrénjiē, kàndào hěn duō rén zài bàinián.
exampleSentences.english: We went to Chinatown and saw lots of people wishing each other a happy New Year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 臺灣在亞洲。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Táiwān zài Yàzhōu.
exampleSentences.english: Taiwan is in Asia.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 臺灣的首都是臺北。
exampleSentences.pinyin: Táiwān de shǒudū shì Táiběi.
exampleSentences.english: The capital of Taiwan is Taipei.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的外婆住在臺灣，每個星期我們打電話聊天。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de wàipó zhùzài Táiwān, měi ge xīngqī wǒmen dǎ diànhuà liáotiān.
exampleSentences.english: My grandma (Mum's mum) lives in Taiwan, and every week we chat on the phone.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽買了臺灣的鳳梨酥，我吃了一塊。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma mǎi le Táiwān de fènglísū, wǒ chī le yí kuài.
exampleSentences.english: Mum bought some Taiwanese pineapple cakes, and I ate one.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我每天上學。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měitiān shàngxué.
exampleSentences.english: I go to school every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 每個人都有一本書。
exampleSentences.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu yǒu yì běn shū.
exampleSentences.english: Everyone has a book.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 每個星期六，我都去踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: měi ge xīngqīliù, wǒ dōu qù tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: Every Saturday I go and play soccer.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 每次放學，媽媽都在校門口等我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: měi cì fàngxué, māma dōu zài xiàomén kǒu děng wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Every time school finishes, Mum waits for me at the school gate.

words.definition: money in a red envelope given as a gift, especially during the Lunar New Year

exampleSentences.hanzi: 紅包是紅色的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hóngbāo shì hóngsè de.
exampleSentences.english: Red envelopes are red.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我今天收到一個紅包。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān shōudào yí ge hóngbāo.
exampleSentences.english: Today I received a red envelope.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 紅包裡有錢，我把錢放進我的存錢罐。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hóngbāo lǐ yǒu qián, wǒ bǎ qián fàng jìn wǒ de cúnqiángguàn.
exampleSentences.english: A red envelope has money in it, and I put the money into my piggy bank.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 奶奶給我一個紅包，我說謝謝奶奶。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai gěi wǒ yí ge hóngbāo, wǒ shuō xièxie nǎinai.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma (Dad's mum) gave me a red envelope, and I said thank you, Grandma.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
exampleSentences.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ lèi le, jiù xiūxi yíxià.
exampleSentences.english: If you are tired, then have a rest.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 如果你吃完飯，就可以吃水果。
exampleSentences.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐ chī wán fàn, jiù kěyǐ chī shuǐguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: If you finish your dinner, then you can have some fruit.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 如果週末不下雨，我們就在公園玩滑梯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: rúguǒ zhōumò bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù zài gōngyuán wán huátī.
exampleSentences.english: If it doesn't rain on the weekend, we'll play on the slide at the park.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 如果校車遲到了，我們就在校門口等。
exampleSentences.pinyin: rúguǒ xiàochē chídào le, wǒmen jiù zài xiàomén kǒu děng.
exampleSentences.english: If the school bus is late, we will wait at the school gate.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 人們在新年放鞭炮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: rénmen zài xīnnián fàngbiānpào.
exampleSentences.english: People set off firecrackers at New Year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們不可以自己放鞭炮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen bù kěyǐ zìjǐ fàngbiānpào.
exampleSentences.english: We must not set off firecrackers by ourselves.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 晚上，我們在窗邊聽到遠處有人放鞭炮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnshang, wǒmen zài chuāngbiān tīngdào yuǎnchù yǒu rén fàngbiānpào.
exampleSentences.english: At night, by the window, we heard people setting off firecrackers far away.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們站在遠一點的地方，看大人放鞭炮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen zhàn zài yuǎn yìdiǎn de dìfang, kàn dàrén fàngbiānpào.
exampleSentences.english: We stood a little way off and watched the grown-ups set off firecrackers.

words.definition: to stick / paste / put up spring festival couplets

exampleSentences.hanzi: 過年前，我們貼春聯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: guònián qián, wǒmen tiēchūnlián.
exampleSentences.english: Before New Year we put up couplets.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 貼春聯的時候，我們要小心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tiēchūnlián de shíhou, wǒmen yào xiǎoxīn.
exampleSentences.english: When we put up couplets, we must be careful.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末，我跟爸爸一起貼春聯，門口很漂亮。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò, wǒ gēn bàba yìqǐ tiēchūnlián, ménkǒu hěn piàoliàng.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend, Dad and I put up the couplets together, and the front door looks lovely.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 奶奶家每年都在門上貼春聯，我最喜歡看。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai jiā měi nián dōu zài ménshang tiēchūnlián, wǒ zuì xǐhuan kàn.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma's house puts up couplets on the door every year, and I love looking at them.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天我要早點起床。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān wǒ yào zǎo diǎn qǐchuáng.
exampleSentences.english: Tomorrow I need to get up early.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天是星期六。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān shì xīngqīliù.
exampleSentences.english: Tomorrow is Saturday.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天我們去公園踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān wǒmen qù gōngyuán tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: Tomorrow we are going to the park to play soccer.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 明天我們要去海灘，我要帶泳衣。
exampleSentences.pinyin: míngtiān wǒmen yào qù hǎitān, wǒ yào dài yǒngyī.
exampleSentences.english: Tomorrow we are going to the beach, so I need to bring my swimsuit.
